summary: Full-stack validation of Cuentapatas PWA (backend + frontend). 10/10 pytest tests passed covering /api/config, full AI pipeline (create+upload+generate+poll), paywall unlock, public slug page, media serving, rate-limit (429 on 4th generation), admin login (success+401), admin metrics (avg_cost_clp well under 600 CLP guardrail) and admin stories table. Frontend e2e happy path PASSED: Landing -> wizard (name, species=perro, 2 traits regalon+payaso) -> theme Dieciochero -> upload 3 real pet JPEGs -> generate -> carousel appeared (<120s) with first 2 slides unlocked and later slides showing VISTA PREVIA lock overlay -> paywall-pay-button unlocked story and download/share buttons appeared. Admin page: login with Cuentapatas.2026 renders KPIs (7 Historias, 28.6% conv, $7.980 ingresos, $34 costo IA/historia) and stories table (7 rows).
critical_code_review_comments: Rate-limit counts stories by generated_at timestamp per device, which is correct, but it does not decrement if a prior generation failed; low-impact.
server.py pay_demo updates slides regardless of story existence prior check order looks fine. OK.
No automated image cleanup task is wired up for PHOTO_RETENTION_DAYS; relies on manual/cron cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Backend test module auto-creates ~5 TEST stories (TestPatas + 3 rate-limit RL + 1 Firulais via UI). Admin metrics show them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limit of 3/day/device is strict; use a fresh X-Device-Id UUID per pipeline test. Pipeline typically completes in 15-90s. Real pet JPEGs are at /tmp/dog1.jpg..dog3.jpg (unsplash). Playwright trait testids use ASCII (e.g. trait-chip-regalon, trait-chip-payaso) - DO NOT use 'chistoso' which is not an actual trait option.
